verdict.rationale: Team shared vaults are a fair axis for a password manager and authenticator, but the evidence shows no shared vaults or collections and no per-member access control. 2FAS Share sends one-off, end-to-end encrypted links with expiration; that is an adjacent feature, not team vault sharing. Token 'groups' and 'Security Tiers' are personal organization and device-access controls, not multi-member permissions.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control
